title: Replit Ends Its Partnership With Anthropic, CEO Confirms
excerpt: Replit has stopped working with Anthropic due to various factors, including cost, according to the company's CEO.
body_html:
Replit is no longer collaborating with Anthropic, according to a statement from the company's CEO, Masad. The decision to end the relationship was driven by several different factors, which include cost considerations.

Previously, Replit had announced a partnership with OpenAI in August. However, prior to the CEO's statement regarding Anthropic, there had been no public indication that the collaboration with Anthropic had ended.
